en.description:
Unleash endless fun with our collection of 4 mini-games, each offering a unique and engaging experience right on your Apple Watch:

1. Chinese Dice Game “大话骰”
Immerse yourself in the classic Chinese Dice Game ‘大话骰’ right on your wrist. Challenge your luck and strategy in a game of bluff and prediction. Perfect for quick entertainment or passing time with friends, without the need for physical dice.

2. Bottle Game
Spin the bottle with a tap or a swipe on your Apple Watch. A timeless game made portable and private, perfect for making decisions, playing truth or dare, or just having fun wherever you are. Let the digital bottle decide your fate!

3. Tic Tac Toe
Enjoy the classic game of Tic Tac Toe on your Apple Watch. A simple yet addictive game where strategy meets luck. Play against the clock or challenge yourself in this timeless grid game that’s perfect for quick breaks.

4. Angry Emoji
Dodge the wrath of the Angry Emoji in this quirky, engaging game. Keep the emoji happy with quick decisions and watch out for sudden mood swings. A fun and humorous way to pass the time, with each level offering new challenges to keep you entertained.

5. Poker Cards Simulation:  virtual deck at your fingertips, perfect for quick, on-the-go entertainment.
en.subtitle: No Ads Quick watch Duel Games

zh.trackName: 手表大话骰, 井字棋, 瓶子和其他单挑模拟游戏
zh.description:
解锁我们的4款迷你游戏集合，每一款都在你的Apple Watch上提供独特而吸引人的体验：

-大话骰
极速大话骰子游戏模拟器, 迅速开始游戏。忘记带实体的骰子没关系，一台Apple Watch就能让您随时随地享受骰子游戏的乐趣！

-扑克牌模拟
随时随地，一副虚拟牌在指尖，完美适合快速娱乐。

-瓶子游戏
通过在你的Apple Watch上轻触或滑动来旋转瓶子。一个经典游戏变得便携且私密，非常适合做决定、玩真心话大冒险，或者在任何地方享受乐趣。让数字瓶子决定你的命运！"

-井字棋
在你的Apple Watch上享受经典的井字棋游戏。一个简单却上瘾的游戏，在这里策略与运气相遇。在这个永恒的格子游戏中与时间赛跑或挑战自己，非常适合快速休息时间。

-愤怒的表情符号
在这个古怪而吸引人的游戏中躲避生气的表情符号的愤怒。通过快速决策让表情符号保持快乐，并注意突然的情绪波动。一个有趣且幽默的消磨时间方式，每个级别都提供新的挑战，让你保持娱乐。
zh.releaseNotes: 将所需的最低版本降低至8.0
